auth_sub_mode.description: In case of API mandate, sub auth mode type

created_at.description: Timestamp at which mandate was created

id.description: Unique ID to identify mandates provided by Digio.

mandate_id.description: Unique ID to identify mandates provided by Digio.

npci_auth_failed_error.description: Failure reason if shared by NPCI after rejecting a request at NPCI gateway level

npci_auth_reject_reason.description: Failure reason if shared by bank post NPCI gateway acceptence

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp of the mandate

identifier.description: This denotes what type of identifier was used

identifier_value.description: Identifier for sub-user, this is generally emailID or mobile number

entity_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent entity the access token belongs to

id.description: Unique identifier referencing an access token

valid_till.description: DateTime at which the access token expires. New token can be generated when expired with the access token generation API mentioned in the document.

details.description: Details about the exception. Usually contains the exception id for reference.

auth_mode.description:
Authentication mode for mandate. Possible values are:
'upi'

corporate_config_id.description:
Corporate profile created from dashboard has below info and is auto populated during user authentication.
Utility Code
Service provider name
Sponsor bank name
Sponsor bank 
Sponsor bank ifsc

expire_in_days.description: Please pass this value to allow the end user to be able to submit the mandate image (in case of physical mandate) or perform eSign authentication within ‘X’ days. X you can pass as the value

generate_access_token.description: If true, will receive an access_token object in response. access_token used to bypass first factor authentication in SDKs.

include_authentication_url.description: Pass True if authentication link is required in response payload based on above customer’s identifier

mandate_type.description:
Type of mandate to be created: 
'create': 
'amend':

notify_customer.description: Set true to send notification to customer with a gateway link to authenticate/sign the mandate. Else, false

sub_user_identifier.description: If mandate needs to be reflected to specific sub-user

auth_type.description: Mode of authentication used for mandate

collection_amount.description: For fixed amount mandate, this denotes the amount

customer_account_type.description: Type of bank account of customer

customer_identifier.description: Identifier for customer, could be email or mobile number

customer_ref_number.description: Unique Reference Number identifier the customer

destination_bank_id.description: IFSC code of customer's bank account

file_name.description: Name of file shared with the bank

frequency.description: In case of recurring mandate, denotes the frequency.

is_recurring.description: Denotes whether it is a recurring mandate or not

maximum_amount.description: Maximum amount that may be collected from the customer's account

npci_txn_id.description: Transaction ID in reference to NPCI

scheme_ref_number.description: Unique number maintained by Corporate for the reconciliation

account_validation.description: Set to true if mandate should be auto revoked in case the customer’s account number shared by merchant in “customer_account_number” is different then the account number used by customer to authenticate the UPI mandate.

auto_debit_amount_in_paise.description: Default 100 ( 1 Rs Auto Debit) Note: Only applicable in case auto debit amount needs to be customized. It should be less than maximum_amount

customer_account_number.description:
Customer bank account number
Min len = 8 Max len = 18
All numeric

customer_name.description:
Recommended that the name is same as per Destination Bank records
Max len = 100

customer_ref_number.description:
Reference number maintained by Corporate
e.g.: Customer_id, Loan account number, Folio number, Insurance policy number etc
Max len = 20, ALPHA and NUMERIC allowed
Note : Please pass this attribute unique for each mandate created, as many sponsor banks consider it as a unique identifier at their end.

final_collection_date.description: Date for Last Debit in yyyy-mm-dd

first_collection_date.description: Date for First Debit in yyyy-mm-dd ; means the date from which you want the mandate to be registered Note : Ideally it should be the current date on which the mandate is created. So auto debit can be successful

frequency.description:
If is_recurring : true, pass debit frequency.

Note: Choose one from below, commensurate with your use case category (Management Category Code) eg: 7322 (Loan Installment should have a defined frequency that is commensurate with the EMI schedule agreed upon with the customer eg: Monthly). Incorrect frequency passed for a management category, may lead to mandate registration failure.
Adhoc [means “As on when presented”]
IntraDay
Daily
Weekly
Monthly
BiMonthly
Quarterly
Semiannually
Yearly

include_upi_url.description: This is used if intent url is required in the response

is_recurring.description:
True / False
Pass False if its a one-time debit

maximum_amount.description:
Maximum amount that may be collected from the customer's account, per instruction eg: 4500.50

Note: Either of collection_amount or maximum_amount is mandatory.

UPI AutoPay Additional Factor of Authentication (AFA) (viz. UPI PIN) limit has been relaxed from 15,000/- to 2,00,000/- for the below Merchant Category Codes (MCC).
MCC  Description
5413: Credit Card Bill Payments
5960: Direct Marketing Insurance Services
6012: Financial Institutions Merchandise and Services
6211: Securities brokers and dealers
6300: Insurance sales, underwriting and premiums
6381: Insurance Premiums
6399: Insurance
6529: LIC

scheme_ref_number.description:
Additional Reference number maintained by Corporate for the reconciliation
E.g: Loan account number, Folio number, Insurance policy number etc
Max len = 20, ALPHA and NUMERIC allowed

is_enabled_for_aadhaar_auth.description: It is only applicable for API mandate and it returns true/false. If the sponsor bank supports authentication using aadhaar then it returns true, else it returns false.
